subject: CParticle / CFX particle system — emitter layout, particle slot encoding, and effect IDs
overview: GTA:SA's particle system uses two layers: CParticle (the legacy GTA III-era simple particles) and the newer CFxSystem / CFxManager effect system. Most visual effects (explosions, gunfire, fire, smoke, weather rain/snow) use CFxSystem. CParticle handles legacy effects that were never migrated.

CParticleSystemData_layout.description: Each active particle is stored in a CParticleData slot. The game maintains a fixed array of 8192 slots.

key_fields.name: m_fSize
key_fields.description: Current billboard size in world units

key_fields.name: m_nLife
key_fields.description: Remaining life ticks. 0 = dead and slot available.

key_fields.name: m_color
key_fields.description: ABGR packed colour at creation; fades toward m_colorTarget

key_fields.name: m_colorTarget
key_fields.description: ABGR target colour at end of life

CFxSystem_overview.description: CFxSystem replaces CParticle for most modern GTA:SA effects. Each system is defined in an .FXP binary effect file and managed by the singleton CFxManager. At runtime, new effects are created by CFxManager::CreateFxSystem with an effect name.
CFxSystem_overview.effect_data_path: effects.fxp  (packed in the main IMG streams)

particle_type_ids.description: CParticle type IDs for legacy particles (still used for weather and some HUD effects).
